name: KG Mobility Corp.
summary: KG Mobility Corp. manufactures and sells automobiles and parts in the South Korea and internationally. The company offers a range of SUVs under the Rexton, Korando, Actyon Sports, XLV, and Tivoli brand name; and products under the TORRES, KORANDO e-MOTION, MUSSO, and MUSSO GRAND name. KG Mobility Corp. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Pyeongtaek-si, South Korea. KG Mobility Corp. is a subsidiary of KG Eco Solution Co.,Ltd.
